Hi, here Ines! I am an Agronomist, current PhD student at [Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile](https://www.uc.cl/en) since 2026 and member of the Atacama Desert UC Center [CDA](https://cda.uc.cl/). I am now beginning my PhD research after spending more than two years working on establishing hydroponic crops using fog water at two locations of the Atacama Desert: Alto Patache, Iquique and Falda Verde, Chañaral. 

From the second half of 2023 to the end of 2025 I worked with UC professor Francisco Albornoz, PhD, on the FONDECYT project 13220028 titled *"Establishing the basis for the use of fog water as the main source of irrigation water for agricultural production across the coastal Atacama Desert"* funded by ANID (Chile's National Agency for Research and Development). Through this project I had the opportunity to conduct scientific research related to water scarcity and work with local communities, including the "Atacama Fogcatchers association" in Chañaral.

I have also organized events related with our work, including the 2024, 2025 and 2026 editions of [Lechuga Fest](https://www.lechugafest.cl/inicio), an event that brings together hydroponic companies, suppliers, producers and agronomy students, as well as the international seminar ["Agriculture in the desert using alternative sources of water and renewable energies"](https://www.uc.cl/noticias/atrapar-las-nubes-la-uc-crea-red-global-para-obtener-agua-de-niebla/) organized by the CDA in May 2026.

My background includes working for chilean and multinational companies on improving irrigation techniques, agricultural technology transfer and technologies such as irrigation control software, IoT sensors, drone imagery and shovelomics. I also have experience in seed production of crops such as maize, soybeans and sorghum, among others. I am very interested in ag-technology, water use efficiency and everything related to the desert.

I enjoy talking to people, taking photos and sharing my research! That's why I also share my work, travels, and everyday experiences as a PhD student on my [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/agroine.ruta/) profile, where I can communicate in a more casual and approachable way and you can follow a more personal and behind-the-scenes look at my journey.

You can see some of my photos related with the proyect, the desert and more at the [me now](https://inevilches.github.io/) section!
